selections.comment: CHAIRMANFOURTIMES helped set a fast pace over 6f at Ayr last time and paid the price in the closing stages. He could only manage third on that occasion, but a return to this minimum trip is the logical move and Adrian Keatley's charge could prove hard to stop. Cloudbuster has a similar chance to the selection, having placed over 6f here on her latest start. She could land a blow, while Enjoy The Night is a likely improver on today's faster ground.

selections.comment: EEETEE will likely prove a popular choice, as he escapes a penalty for last week's emphatic victory in an apprentices' race at Redcar. Jack Nicholls can also claim his full 7lb allowance on this occasion, so another bold bid looks on the cards. Nottingham winner Louie The Legend steps up in class raised 4lb, but Project Geofin faces an easier assignment on his return to a mile and the top weight could prove a bigger danger off his current mark.

Make Me King returned from a four-month layoff to finish a solid third in a Group 3 race in France and can make his presence felt, while Boiling Point should also be sharper for a recent outing at Newcastle.

selections.comment: CHARMING PRINCESS has had to make do behind some talented sorts of William Haggas the last twice, but she pulled well clear of the field when beaten a head at Ffos Las recently and that form should be enough to see her break the maiden. Hopeful Joy must be considered on the back of a strong runner-up effort at Ripon, while 425,000gns purchase Golden Horse looks like the pick of the newcomers for leading connections.

Elegant Erin should find this easier than her latest seventh in a class 2 event at Newcastle and is feared most, ahead of Brummell.

selections.comment: This looks like a pretty simple enough task for CHAIRMANFOURTIMES, as there aren't really any newcomers that catch the eye in this, and he does have plenty of experience compared to most of these. With two 2nd place finishes in his first two races, he did slightly disappoint when the favourite last time out, only managing a 3rd place finish. He can put that experience to good use here and finally get off the mark at the fourth time of asking. Cloudbuster sets the standard with the mark of 67 here; she has seemingly improved with each run and could go well enough to land a 2nd place spot here. And  Valor Spirit has finished 3rd in both of his runs so far; he might have to settle with filling the places once again.

selections.comment: EEETEE has been in pretty good form in his last few races, landing a class 6 handicap contest at Redcar back in June over the mile trip. He has since gone on to win again; this time it was a class 5 contest over the mile trip at the same venue. He clearly has a love for Redcar, but given his current form, you have to take him very seriously wherever he runs. Just 2 lb higher than his first win of the season back in June, he can go well and notch up another victory under his name. Anjo Bonita is yet to really feature since changing to Sara Ender's yard, but she has crept down the weights recently to a potentially attractive mark. The yard is also going well at the moment with the horses they have. And Arkenstaar is another one on a decent-looking mark at present; he can run well and claim 3rd spot here.

selections.comment: Last year's winner, POINT LYNAS, absolutely bolted up in the contest a year ago, and he has since gone on to run very well in some pretty hot contests. He almost stole it from the front in the G2 Summer Mile at Ascot last time and was probably a shade unlucky to not get his head in front that day, but he was ultimately worn down by a very progressive winner who could be a G1 winner soon. Back down in class, on ground that he loves, in a race that he bolted up in last year, I can see the Ed Bethell horse going off at a pretty short price in this. Make Me King was not beaten that far at all in a G3 over in France last time out; that looks to be a pretty strong contest on paper, so he can go well here but might have to settle for a 2nd place finish behind an in-form rival. And Prague probably does some of his best running on ground with a bit of give in it, but there is no doubt he is a talented animal for Dylan Cunha, but he might have to settle with filling the places on his unfavored ground here.

selections.comment: A tricky contest with some pretty tricky types, it could present as a pretty good opportunity for RAULIN, who has won one race in eight career starts, which was a three and a quarter length victory over the 1m2f trip at Redcar back in May, on his second start after the gelding operation. He has since placed once and run 4th on two other occasions, and subsequently has crept back down into the 70s for his handicap mark. He did win off the mark of 75, and now just 4 lb higher, he could be primed and ready to strike here. Time Tells All won his first contest of his career last time out, when landing a handicap contest at Beverley by 3 lengths in the end, winning going away in the end. He has a 6 lb raise in the weights to deal with here, but he can run well and place here. And Looks Fantastic hails from a yard going well at present; he is yet to win in five career starts but has been running ok recently, and he could be the one to fill the places.

selections.comment: VENTURA EXPRESS has won six races in his career and is currently 4 lb lower than his last winning mark, which came at Beverley back in July of last year. He seems to put his best foot forward at this time of year, and although he has raced on pretty much every ground possible, the better the ground, the more chance he has of winning. A decent enough 2nd at Beverley last time out; if he can replicate his Beverley form at this venue, then he will be hard to peg back in this contest. He looks like he could be well handicapped at present and looks primed and ready to go in and win here. Elegant Erin has plenty of experience under her belt, and she looks to be sliding down to an attractive mark once again. She finished 2nd on her last three starts before the last one, and she might have to settle for the bridesmaid position once again. And Spirit Of Applause can run well and fill the places here for a team going pretty well at the moment.

selections.comment: DESERT BEAUTY got her head in front for the very first time in nine races last time out; she was a 1 and a quarter length winner of a class 6 handicap contest at Leicester, keeping on well in the closing stages, looking like the sort that could strike again next time out now the iron is hot. She has just the 3 lb raise in the weights to deal with, which looks lenient, as well as the services of Jim Crowley, which is a very eye-catching jockey booking for connections. Now with her head in front for the first time, she can run well and go in again here. Gis A Sub has plenty of experience under his belt and did bounce back to some sort of form last time out when coming 2nd at Ripon; he can back that up with another 2nd place finish in this contest. And Rain Cap, who is another experienced runner, came 2nd last time out as well but might have to settle with filling the places in this.

selections.comment: DIGNAM is expected to defy a penalty for a recent win on these shores. The Irish raider showed a good turn of foot when outclassing his rivals last week and his flat form suggests there is much more to come. Junkyard Dog placed on debut in Ireland for the same yard before changing hands and is feared most on his stable debut ahead of former French winner Split who could do with some more rain on his first run for his yard.

selections.comment: An open race where top weight QUEENS WISH gets the verdict having caught the eye last time finishing strongly having been outpaced at a key stage. Although she may want a bit further in time this stiffer track will suit and she is well treated on her winning form for her old yard. Consistent maiden Jlow is feared most with the addition of cheekpieces hopefully improving his finishing effort while Milajess who has been thriving since getting her head in front is also respected. Her last effort is worth marking up as she did too much too soon and she's been freshened up since.

selections.comment: An open contest where most of the field can be given a chance but STROLL ON BY gets the narrow verdict. He cashed in on a lower hurdles mark last time showing a willing attitude and remains very well treated on his chase form. He's entitled to come on for that first outing of the year and if building on it can defeat last year's winner Enthused who races off the same mark this time. He ran well in a much better race than this last time when poorly positioned behind a stablemate and unsuited by the sharp track. Hat trick seeker Breaking Cover is also hugely respected returned to handicaps off a potentially lenient mark if turned out quickly.

selections.comment: A few can be given a chance here but WASDELL DUNDALK is expected to make amends for last time where he was given an awful ride left with far too much to do but finished strongly. The handicapper has generously left him alone 3lb below his last winning mark and this stiff track will be in his favour. Young Buster looks the pick of the Fergal O'Brien pair and is feared most having bounced back to form last time. However he won't get it all his own way in front today and could help set it up for a closer such as the progressive Harrys Hope who is forgiven defeat on her follow up attempt last time as the race came too soon.

selections.comment: A strong contest where a host can be given a chance. Recent C&D winner EARTH KING is marginally preferred though as he did it decisively last time and remains well treated on his novice form despite a 4lb rise. Keel Strand looks the biggest danger in his bid for a 4 timer with the step back up in trip a big positive. He's only been raised 3lb for gamely beating a next time out winner so ought to hold every chance. Top weight Minella Rescue brings in strong Grade 1 novice form and should be able to reverse recent placings with Saint Bibiana on these revised terms.

selections.comment: Another tight contest but ASLUKWOODHAVIT hinted at better when midfield in a small field last time and holds strong claims here if building on that. That looked a good contest for the grade and he's entitled to improve for what was just his second run for this yard. He is very well treated on his Irish form and his experience could tell against chase debutant Raby Mere who has been progressive over hurdles recently. That rival represents a stable with an excellent record here and should go close off a lenient mark if his jumping holds up. Presentandcounting may ideally want 3m but he has slipped to a dangerous mark and his rivals won't want to allow him a freebie in front at this stiff track. He completes the list of dangers.

selections.comment: An extremely strong contest where Sixty Plus is likely to prove popular in his hat trick bid if turned out quickly under another penalty. He never came off the bridle that day but his rivals in behind weren't ridden optimally and he could be vulnerable to the equally well treated LA QUARITE who is thrown in on his easy chase win last time. He also looks well treated on his final maiden run over hurdles and should be tough to beat if this race doesn't come too soon. Of the others top weight Nottodaybobo makes some small appeal. He caught the eye on stable debut finishing strongly over an inadequate 2m and is thrown in on his old Irish form over both hurdles and fences. He can pose a serious challenge to the front pair in the betting.
